```yaml
name: Regression Tests
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.8, 3.9, "3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]
        test-group: [fast, network, slow, core]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install pytest pytest-xdist pytest-cov

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          case "${{ matrix.test-group }}" in
            fast)
              pytest -xvs -k "not network and not slow and not regression" --tb=short
              ;;
            network)
              pytest -xvs -k "network and not slow and not regression" --tb=short
              ;;
            slow)
              pytest -xvs -k "slow and not regression" --tb=short
              ;;
            core)
              pytest -xvs -k "core and not regression" --tb=short
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: coverage.xml
          flags: unittests

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: Test Results
          path: "*.xml"
          reporter: java-junit
```
